title: OpenLearnLM Benchmark: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Knowledge, Skill, and Attitude in Educational Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus was on evaluating LLMs in educational contexts across three dimensions: Knowledge (subject and pedagogical), Skills (scenario-based competencies), and Attitude (alignment and deception).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as these topics were outside the scope of the educational benchmark.
